c74object.name: naka.miseru
c74object.digest: Brightness, colour and white warmth to DMX values, the miseru way
c74object.description: naka.miseru turns a light's look (brightness, colour strength, hue and the warmth of its white) into DMX channel values, with the same fixture definitions and maths as the miseru lighting app. RGBW, CCT and cross-fade fixtures are all driven by the same four numbers. It only converts: connect its outlet to naka.artnet or naka.dmxusbpro to reach the lights.

outlet.digest: ch 1 <values...>: the frame up to the last patched channel

method.name: patch
method.description: Types: dimmer, rgb, rgbw, dim-rgb, dim-rgbw, arri-l7c, diva-lite. Address 1-512. Lights cannot share channels.

method.name: studio
method.digest: Load the TMU photo studio patch (arri1-3, diva1-4)

method.name: look
method.description: target is a light name, a group name or all. intensity and sat are 0-1 (sat 0 = white, 1 = colour only), hue is 0-360, cct is the white's colour temperature in kelvin.

method.name: blackout
method.digest: All lights dark; looks are kept

method.name: allon
method.digest: Switch on the lights that are off, at full brightness

method.name: reset
method.digest: Every light back to off, white, 5600 K
